notRepoDesc: {cwd} is not inside a git repository, so there is nothing to commit.
emptyDesc: Files the worker changes show up here, ready to review and commit.
preexisting: {n} file was already changed before this task | {n} files were already changed before this task
preexistingDesc: They are not this task's work, so they are not offered for commit here.

diff.empty: No line changes (mode or rename only).
diff.caption: Changes in {path}: {additions} added, {deletions} removed
diff.hidden: {n} more line hidden. | {n} more lines hidden.
diff.truncated: This diff is too large and was cut short.

commit.title: Commit this task's files
commit.desc: Only the files you tick are committed; anything else you staged stays as it is.
commit.renameNote: A renamed file is committed together with the removal of its old path.
commit.hiddenNote: {n} file in untracked folders is not listed here. Open its folder in the file list to commit it. | {n} files in untracked folders are not listed here. Open a folder in the file list to commit its files.
commit.active: The worker is still running. Commit when the task has finished.
commit.busy: Another git action is still running.

outside.title: Changes outside the edit tools
outside.desc: What the turn changed through shell commands and other programs, compared with the snapshot taken before it.
outside.empty: Nothing changed outside the edit tools.
outside.hint: What the worker's turns changed through shell commands and other programs, outside the edit tools.

notice.unknown: This task did not record the commit it started from (it is older than that, or its folder was not in git then). Only uncommitted changes are shown, compared with HEAD; commits are not listed.
notice.unreachable: The commit this task started from ({sha}) is no longer in the history of HEAD (rebased, reset or switched away). Only uncommitted changes are shown, compared with HEAD.
notice.branchChanged: This task started on {from}; the repository is now on {to}. The commits listed are everything since the start on the current branch.
notice.historyUnavailable: The commits since this task started could not be read this time (git took too long or an object is missing). Uncommitted changes are shown as usual; “Read again” tries again.

history.title: Committed in this task
history.desc: Commits made during this task's turns, then any other commits since it started. View only: this work is already committed.
history.more: {n} older commit not shown | {n} older commits not shown
history.noFiles: This commit changes no files compared with its first parent.
history.diffSkipped: This file's diff is past the size limit and is not shown.
history.sinceStart: Whole change since the task started
history.noUncommittedDesc: Everything this task changed is in its commits above.
history.othersGroup: {n} other commit since the task started | {n} other commits since the task started
history.othersHint: Made while none of this task's turns ran: someone else's, or between turns. Their files are not counted as this task's.
history.sinceStartNote: Compared with the task's start, so other commits to this file since then are included.

repo.title: Elsewhere in the repository
repo.summary: {n} other changed file | {n} other changed files
repo.desc: Uncommitted changes in this repository that are not this task's work. They are never offered for commit here.

dir.label: Untracked folders
dir.more: and {n} more file | and {n} more files
dir.others: {n} other file here is not this task's | {n} other files here are not this task's

image.lfs: Stored with Git LFS: the repository holds a pointer, not the image.
image.missing: This version of the file does not exist.
image.broken: The image could not be shown.
